hook: Iceland Mein Machhar Kyun Nahi The?

points.title: Sadiyon tak zero machhar
points.text: Iceland duniya ki gini-chuni jagah thi jahan machhar nahi milte the.

points.title: Oct 2025 ka twist
points.text: Kjos mein pehli baar 3 machhar mile. Garmi badhne se pahunche.

takeaway: Badalta mausam ab Iceland tak pahunch gaya.
